name: James
brief: "Brother of the Lord" (kinsman), leader of the Jerusalem church
short: James, called "the brother of the Lord" (Gal 1:19), led the church in Jerusalem and wrote the Epistle of James. Scripture calls him one of the Lord's "brothers" (Matt 13:55), a word used for kinsmen; the Church holds that Mary remained ever-virgin and bore no other children. St Jerome took the brethren to be cousins, sons of Mary the wife of Clopas; Eastern tradition holds them sons of Joseph by an earlier marriage.
